text:
Zara Osei: Hi team — Zara joining Product Infra as platform engineer. First day, woo! Quick: my Mac prompted for an MDM PIN but I never got an invite. Who should I ping?

Jamie Park: Welcome Zara! :tada: Ping Lina (IT) for MDM. I'll DM you a buddy.

Samir Chen: hey Zara, congrats. I can pair on a first PR later today.

Lina (IT): Hi Zara — re-sent Okta Device Management invite to zara.osei@redwood.ai. If it doesn't appear check Promotions/Spam. After install run `profiles status -type enrollment` to confirm.

Zara Osei: Checked spam, nothing. Laptop serial is ABC123XYZ.

Lina (IT): Thanks — manual token created and provisioning pushed. You should see "Compliant" shortly.

ops-bot: Provisioning: user zara.osei created; teams: platform-engineering; channels: #platform,#dev-oncall.

Zara Osei: Enrolled and compliant now. SSH into the dev jump host fails with `Permission denied (publickey)`. I uploaded my pubkey to onboarding repo but maybe wrong path.

Jamie Park: Put a file named zara.pub under onboarding-keys in the repo with your GitHub handle. @ops-bot can sync keys.

ops-bot: SSH key sync initiated for zara.osei — complete.

Zara Osei: SSH works now, thanks! One last ask: where's the first-week checklist?

Jamie Park: Internal doc at https://docs.redwood.ai/onboarding/first-week. TL;DR: enroll MDM, add SSH key, request 2FA/YubiKey, join channels, shadow on-call, small PR. I'll add a 1pm onboarding sync.

Kevin (Security): Welcome! Reply to ops-ticket #9876 if you want a YubiKey shipped.

Alyssa (Design): welcome to Toronto folks! lunch group link in #random. Fun fact thread: what do you build outside work?

Zara Osei: I bake sourdough on weekends. Looking forward to working with you all! :bread: :sparkles:
